# Vendored highlight.js

Pinned version: **11.11.1**, BSD 3-Clause license (`LICENSE`).
Official distribution: https://github.com/highlightjs/cdn-release/tree/11.11.1/build
API: https://highlightjs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api.html

Files and SHA-256:

- `highlight.min.js`: `c4a399dd6f488bc97a3546e3476747b3e714c99c57b9473154c6fb8d259b9381`
- `github-dark.min.css`: `9f208d022102b1d0c7aebfecd8e42ca7997d5de636649d2b31ea63093d809019`
- `LICENSE`: `6c081431591d9df696c82dc598fe1423765b8a299b200ed00b281afd0f64c490`

Loaded locally by solution, task and participant overview shells. Source text
is inserted using `textContent` before `highlightElement`; no remote assets,
language auto-detection, execution, Markdown parsing or math rendering are used
for code. Original text is retained separately for copy/download. The included
common-language bundle supports C++ and Python.
